message.content: In the conversation recorded on 20260910_12:00, Emily Burnett asks Li Hua if he has ever encountered someone as quirky and brilliant as Sheldon Cooper, a character from the television show "The Big Bang Theory." Li Hua responds by saying, "Not really! I mean, he’s one of a kind, right? I do meet interesting people, but nobody quite like him!" This indicates that Li Hua has not personally met anyone in real life who matches the characteristics of Sheldon Cooper.
